name: Rocket
blurb: Rocket is an intuitive new way of...
description:
Rocket is an intuitive new way of... bah, whatever. It's a
sync-tracker, a tool for synchronizing music and visuals in
demoscene productions. It consists of a GUI editor (using Qt5), and
an ANSI C library that can either communicate with the editor over
a network socket, or play back an exported data-set.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
